title: ArtifactRef
description: A reference to something Gyst has seen. Separates the physical Location where a version was observed, the ArtifactVersion identified by content, and the logical Artifact that grouping assigns. Only 'location' is a raw fact; 'artifact' is a rebuildable projection and must never be treated as evidence.

version.description: Identifies the observed state of the content itself. Absent under 'exclude' or 'metadata' content policy, where Gyst may know a path exists without being permitted to read it.

version_id.description: Core-assigned stable id for this version. Absent on connector output; assigned on ingestion.

artifact.description: PROJECTION, NOT EVIDENCE. The logical grouping a given identity profile assigned. Present only on derived records and query results, never on a raw connector observation. Carries the profile and policy version so the grouping can be explained and rebuilt after a profile change.
